method: Each of the four listed PNGs was opened and visually inspected using view_image; dimensions and SHA-256 were read from the exact local files.
overall_result: No blocking visual defects in the four observed 1280x720 frames.
scope_limits: No interaction was performed; screenshot readability does not establish runtime behavior.
No claims are made about unviewed screenshots, other resolutions, or other scroll positions.

screenshots.observed_feature: Tag is selected; nearby-terrain/inventory/XP explanation is visible. Completion estimate is fully readable: up to 8 Supplies, 55 crew XP, 6 reputation, and 20 training XP. Start Tag and Crew House actions are visible.
screenshots.clipping: No visible text or control clipping; the explanation wraps to two lines and the entire reward estimate fits.
screenshots.readability: Large high-contrast text; selected activity and reward estimate use distinct colors. Disabled Quick game state is visibly dimmed.
screenshots.coverage_limit: This frame verifies the displayed preview only, not reward acceptance or activity execution.

screenshots.observed_feature: Current damage, critical chance/multiplier, area, vitality, attack/artifact interval, pickup range, and recovery are visible. Artifact families 0/3 and the empty-state guidance are present, with Build paths, Room contract, Scout reward caches, and Return to Minecraft controls.
screenshots.clipping: No visible clipping or overlap; the empty-state sentence fits above the lower actions.
screenshots.readability: Stat rows and controls remain readable. Pit stop (0) is visibly disabled.
screenshots.coverage_limit: Only the empty artifact state is shown; populated artifact lists and longer scrolled content are not verified.

screenshots.observed_feature: Cryo shatter page 1/6 shows Venom ink 0/3 and Chill paint 0/3, the headliner forge requirement, and the full trigger/effect explanation. Text describes the 3-active-second interval, four visible owned rivals, 10 base damage, six-block range, and area scaling capped at 12.
screenshots.clipping: No visible clipping; the long effect description wraps onto a second line and ends above the scroll hint and action row.
screenshots.readability: Recipe title, missing prerequisites, and forge explanation have clear visual separation. Previous-page and Defeat a headliner controls are visibly disabled; next-page arrow and Back to build are visible.
screenshots.coverage_limit: Only Cryo shatter page 1/6 is shown; other recipes, successful forging, and additional scroll positions are not verified.

screenshots.observed_feature: Banked and returned status and album-retention explanation are visible. The frame shows Free streets, 5:02 active time, level 2, score 190, two rivals, two cards, arena/headliner/contract/service totals, and damage/vitality/ward rows. Scroll hint, Set up another run, and Crew House navigation are visible.
screenshots.clipping: No visible overlap or accidental clipping in the displayed rows; the last visible statistic remains above the scroll hint and actions.
screenshots.readability: Status, session summary, and numeric rows are readable with consistent spacing.
screenshots.coverage_limit: Accepted reward quantities are not visible in this top-of-list frame despite the header mentioning accepted rewards. A scroll hint is visible; this image alone does not verify receipt quantities or recipient details.
